name: Successful end-to-end train booking process

steps.name: Given the user is on the MakeMyTrip home page
When the user navigates to the Trains section
And the user searches for a train from "Lucknow" to "Delhi" for date "30 May 2026"
Then the user should be on the train listing results page
When the user filters by "AC" and "Available" trains
And the user selects the first available train
And the user adds a traveller named "John Doe" aged "30" with gender "Male"
And the user fills contact details with email "test@example.com" and mobile "9876543210"
And the user enters IRCTC username "TestUser123"
And the user accepts the mandatory terms and clicks pay
And the user completes the payment with card number "4111111111111111", expiry "12/28", cvv "123" for "John Doe"
Then the payment should be processed successfully

fullName: Train Ticket Booking Flow: Successful end-to-end train booking process
